LZMA encoder and decoder from 7-Zip / LZMA SDK 24.09, by Igor Pavlov.
These files are public domain, as stated in their original headers.
Source files are unmodified:
  https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/tree/24.09/C
  7zTypes.h, Compiler.h, Precomp.h, LzmaDec.h, LzmaDec.c,
  LzmaEnc.h, LzmaEnc.c, LzFind.h, LzFind.c, LzHash.h,
  CpuArch.h, CpuArch.c, 7zWindows.h

Built once in the shared aero_io library for native mesh I/O. No installed 7-Zip program is required.
